name: ever-gauzy
description: Ever® Gauzy™ - Open Business Management Platform (ERP/CRM/HRM/ATS/PM) - https://gauzy.co
one_liner: A free, all-in-one business back-office app — CRM, payroll, hiring, project tracking — that replaces a stack of separate paid subscriptions with one system you run yourself.
buyer: A small business owner or agency ops manager currently paying for several separate SaaS tools (CRM, HR, invoicing) who wants to consolidate into one self-hosted system.
business_use_cases: An agency self-hosts it to run client billing, timesheets, and hiring in one place instead of paying for Monday.com, BambooHR, and QuickBooks separately.
A retail or restaurant chain uses its inventory and HR modules as a cheaper alternative to a paid ERP suite.
A dev shop white-labels it and resells hosted instances to small businesses as a ready-made 'back office in a box.'

money_ideas.idea: Offer a hosted, managed version billed monthly per business
Charge a one-off fee for migration and setup from a client's existing SaaS stack

steal_this: Spin up a hosted instance this weekend pre-configured for one vertical (e.g. restaurants), and sell it as a 'your back office, done' subscription to a handful of local businesses.
